messages:
marc: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a publisher onboarding for AWS+GCP+Azure this week. Need a clean TOC for the listing: legal artifacts, SKU/pricing bundles, trial entitlements, branding assets, AMI/container images. Who can own packaging assets?

sophie: I can take AWS AMI + screenshots. Will need the final logo assets and a short product blurb (50-75 words). Can someone drop the blurbs here? :pray:

luis: I can handle pricing SKUs and entitlements. Question — do we want a single trial SKU across clouds or per-cloud trial mapping? Azure's publisher portal sometimes needs a distinct trial SKU.

olivia: Recommend per-cloud mapping for now to avoid portal validation errors. Also legal wants a single canonical EULA doc and then per-region translations. I've flagged localization as a blocker for EU launch.

marc: Good call, olivia. luis — please map trial SKUs per cloud then. Sophie — I'll add the 60-word blurb in a bit. For AMIs/containers: sophie, can you standardize tags like: `redwood-inference-2026-<region>`?

marketplace-bot: Reminder: publisher portal invite sent to marc and luis (role: Publisher Admin). Link: https://pubportal.cloud/vendor/invites/abc123

luis: Noted. I'll create a spreadsheet for SKU -> OfferID -> TrialSKU mapping and share. Anyone with billing/tax questions cc @finance.

olivia: Legal checklist: 1) canonical EULA (eng-signed), 2) privacy notice snippet, 3) support contact, 4) export control attestation, 5) KMS/keys statement for private deployment. I'll start a PR on the legal repo.

marc: Thanks. Also need packaging checklist for product assets: logos (SVG/PNG), 2 screenshots, feature bullets (3), pricing tiers table, trial duration (14 days?), sample support ticket flow. Sophie — can you produce screenshots by EOD Thu?

sophie: Yup — aiming Thu EOD. Any specific UI states you want? Login, dashboard with latency graph, and model selection screen?

marc: Those three are perfect. luis — can you confirm pricing tiers and whether to include metered tokens vs flat? We talked about offering both.

luis: I'll propose 2 bundles: Pay-as-you-go (metered tokens) + Reserved (monthly vCPU/GPU hours) with trial credits. Will post numbers by tomorrow.

olivia: One more legal note — some marketplaces require a support SLA in the listing. Can we publish a basic 24/72 SLA matrix (initially 24h response for P1, 72h for non-P1)? Ops okay with that?

marc: Ops summarized earlier said 24/72 is fine for launch. We'll add an escalation path in the listing notes.

marketplace-bot: Action item created: #MP-4822 "Publish listing assets to staging" assigned to sophie, luis due 2026-03-26.

marc: Perf. Next steps: sophie (assets + screenshots), luis (SKU sheet + pricing), olivia (legal doc + translations plan). I'll coordinate publisher portal uploads and do a validation pass on Friday. If anyone hits portal validation errors, ping me and I'll triage with marketplace support.

sophie: Copy that. I'll upload raw assets to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/collab/marketplace/onboard/1715032468-assets

luis: Spreadsheet incoming in 1h.

olivia: Starting legal PR now. Will ping when translations are scheduled.

marc: Thanks team — feel free to @me for blocker escalations. :thumbsup:
